statement: Use your Hunter for Clash of Cans because talents like Stop Right There and Kung Fu Kick give crowd control to get further in waves
Boulder Roller Tower should be high 30s or into the 40s before Clash of Cans or you won't do enough damage
Rest of your towers should be in the 30s with high 20s acceptable
Kraken Tower can be a bit lower level but higher is more effective
Run to the bottom as quickly as possible when summoning Tower Defense because mobs start immediately and you want first towers out fast
Place four Boulder Roller Towers in a line as quickly as possible as the first towers since mobs are speedy
Upgrade the first four Boulder Rollers to level 5 ASAP and choose Trait A so boulders travel farther
After the first four place two more Boulder Roller Towers on the first level in a line
Select Trait A on the two additional Boulder Roller Towers as well
Place Party Starter between the second and third Boulder Roller and upgrade to Trait A ASAP for attack speed
Next place Lightning Towers or Stormcallers and prioritize getting them to level 5 for Trait A
Place a second Stormcaller because Trait A will be really needed for later mobs
Before Wave 21 remove first and fourth Boulder towers and replace with two Frozone Towers and two Party Starter Towers
Place the new Party Starters on the ledge and upgrade all new towers to level 5 ASAP with Trait A on Party Starters
Put Trait B on Frozone Towers for longer freeze time so you have more time to kill mobs running through
Place two more Stormcaller Towers up top for a total of four and use Trait A for extra damage in later waves
To get more Stormcaller attack speed trash the sixth second and third Boulder Rollers and add two Party Starters nearby
If you have enough points add the Kraken Tower placed farther back so Boulder Rollers and Stormcallers deal damage before enemies pass it
Upgrade the new Party Starters to get their attack speed buff
Take Trait B on the Kraken Tower to push mobs back farther since it isn't needed much at this point
At this stage either add more Stormcallers or upgrade all towers to level 10; recommends getting everything to 10 then adding one or two Stormcallers
Don't place Stormcallers on the ground floor because exploding mobs stun towers and cut DPS
With sufficiently upgraded towers you should push past Wave 50 depending on your Construction Workbench tower levels
If you reach Wave 60 to 70 summon more towers such as a second Kraken Tower up top for an extra line of defense against bosses
Otherwise just upgrade towers as much as possible
Adding a few more damaging towers should help you progress through more waves
His run ended at Wave 79; he needs more damage or another setup and thinks this is about his best
